name: Barbell Hang Power Snatch
steps: Stand holding a barbell in a wide overhand snatch grip and hinge at your hips until the bar hangs just above your knees.
Extend your hips, knees, and ankles forcefully to accelerate the bar vertically close to your torso.
Drop quickly into a quarter squat and punch your arms locked straight overhead to receive the bar.
Stand tall to finish the catch, then lower the bar under control back to your hips.
tips: Stay balanced across your whole foot during the hang and avoid rushing your arm pull early.
Lock your elbows decisively overhead and brace your trunk as your feet meet the floor.
